acceptanceCriteria: Packet status reflects the accepted stable profile; citation rules, stop list and serialization are in the packet; sealed vectors include anchored hunks, nonzero specificity, same-path deletion and at least the tamper REJECT classes; a mutation check shows each listed misreading is killed by a vector.
body:
Panel finding (wire and test-conformance lenses). After decision 0525 the producer writes stable cem/1.0 on main, yet the Apache packet says otherwise and is incomplete for V1-0014:
- protocol/cem-1.0/README.md:3-9 "not the stable cem/1.0 profile ... not accepted or implemented"; stable/ALGORITHMS.md:4,:529; stable/OPERATION.json:3 status PROPOSED_EXPERIMENTAL_NOT_IMPLEMENTED.
- The citation rules (CEM-V1-080..082) and the stop list live only in the AGPL spec and Go code; the packet's 16 citation blocks have 0 anchored hunks, specificity 0 and samePathCitations 0 everywhere; the only anchor vectors are generated by the consumer under test (interop/cem01-go/testdata/citation).
- Zero REJECT cases are sealed; R1-EXPECTED.json is DECLARATIVE_NOT_EXECUTED and nothing reads it.
- Serialization (key order, separators), added-bytes join and span-relative defining lines are unspecified; a LF-stripped join misreading survives all 73 fixture hunks.
- The canonical diff recipe is inherited from the 0.3 packet that V1-1278 S3 deletes.
Expected: an implementer with the packet alone reproduces the verdict and citation block byte for byte.

title: protocol/cem-1.0 packet still labelled PROPOSED_EXPERIMENTAL_NOT_IMPLEMENTED and cannot qualify an independent consumer
